description: .NET libraries, a CLI and an MCP server for creating, reading and converting Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF, Visio, OpenDocument, email, Markdown and other documents without Microsoft Office.
rules: Install only the package for the format you work with, such as OfficeIMO.Word, OfficeIMO.Excel, OfficeIMO.PowerPoint or OfficeIMO.Pdf. OfficeIMO doesn't need Microsoft Office, COM automation or a license key.
Create documents inside a using statement, for example using var document = WordDocument.Create("report.docx") or using var workbook = ExcelDocument.Create("sales.xlsx"), and call Save() when done.
For agents that work with local files, use the OfficeIMO.Tool MCP server: dotnet dnx OfficeIMO.Tool mcp serve --stdio, with OFFICEIMO_MCP_ALLOWED_ROOTS naming the folders it may read and write.
Each package's README in its project folder is the current API guide; Docs/ROADMAP.md lists open work, not shipped features.
